scientific_question: Does knowing the nominal-minus-opaque endpoint contrast make the corresponding experimental-lifecycle contrast a reliable surrogate?
analysis_unit: world by fresh provider-trajectory pair; vessels and primitive operations are repeated observations within an arm campaign, not independent samples

development_data_policy.world_seeds_0_through_9: excluded from all confirmatory estimands; used only to choose metrics, threshold and sample size
development_data_policy.g2_v0_4_and_v0_5: pilot evidence only and never pooled with v0.6

primary_estimand.name: sigma_unexplained
primary_estimand.terminal_to_global_best_ratio: score of the sixth final assay divided by the maximum of the six final-assay scores, with the audited metric implementation authoritative
primary_estimand.model: L_wr = alpha + beta * E_wr + categorical_time_block + u_world + epsilon_wr
primary_estimand.world_effect: u_world is a zero-mean Gaussian random intercept
primary_estimand.residual: epsilon_wr is zero-mean Gaussian with standard deviation sigma_unexplained; parameters are estimated by REML
primary_estimand.success_rule: coverage gate passes and the one-sided 95-percent lower bound for sigma_unexplained is greater than 0.15

coverage_gate.failure_branch: confirmatory evidence is inconclusive; no replacement, rerun, outcome-dependent expansion or alternative primary estimand is permitted

censoring_policy.before_any_accepted_operation: at most three immutable attempts for provider infrastructure failure
censoring_policy.after_any_accepted_operation: permanent right censoring with no replacement or rerun
censoring_policy.tipping_point: jointly vary missing lifecycle and endpoint pair contrasts over their mathematical bounds and minimize the primary lower bound; report whether any admissible completion crosses 0.15

secondary_estimands_in_order.name: additional_lifecycle_profile
secondary_estimands_in_order.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the three additional lifecycle metrics

robustness: Student-t residual hierarchical model with degrees of freedom fixed to four
prohibited_adaptations: inspection of interim confirmatory scores or arm contrasts
switching the primary lifecycle or endpoint metric
reintroducing mixed-label, sign-count or exact-zero classification as a confirmatory test

result_branches.primary_success: Endpoint contrast is not a reliable surrogate for experimental lifecycle response in the pre-defined ChemWorld electrochemical world generator: material within-world fresh-trajectory variation remains after endpoint adjustment.
result_branches.coverage_inconclusive: The frozen coverage gate was not met; the audited trajectories remain a complete resource-accounted record but do not decide the primary claim.
result_branches.margin_not_crossed: The endpoint-adjusted lifecycle variation did not clear the pre-defined substantive margin under this design.

implementation.numerical_method: bounded log-variance REML optimization with profile likelihood and deterministic seeds
implementation.freeze_requirement: implementation, tests, this plan, world qualification, full schedule and power report must share an immutable Git commit before the first confirmatory provider call
